katakalyāṇa.cp: adj. one who has done good deeds.
katakalyāṇa.p: [Kata+kalyāṇa] (na) CL=7 (1) Has done good deeds. (Ti) (2) One who has done good deeds. One who has gratitude for what has been done in the past.

katakamma.cp: adj. practised; skilled, having done their own work.
katakamma.p: [Kata+kamma] (na) CL=7 (1) Has good deeds that have been done. (2) Who has done (wholesome deeds, unwholesome deeds). (3) deed of (Sīmāsamuti= abolishing of a former boundary (or) consecrate ground for an ordination hall). (Ti) (4) (A) One who has committed a theft (or) who has done a crime. (B) One who has done some deeds (such as Tajjanīya).

katakicca.p: [Kata+kicca] (na) CL=7 (1) The matter of what should be done. (Ti) (2) Has 16 factors of Magga that have done. One who finished 16 factors of Magga by four factors of Magga.
a: ကိစ္စရှိသော 4

CPD: kata-kicca , mfn. [ cf. BHS kṛtakṛtya, Saddharmap: 1, 7 ]], one who has done what is to be done ( for obtaining aṃatship ) ; in canonical lit. peṃaps exclusively found in verses; according to the exeg. lit. ~ is used of persons who have traversed the four maggas viz. sotâpatti- magga, sakadāgāmimagga, anāgāmimagga, and arahattamagga, having fulfilled the tasks prescribed for each magga; the texts mention 16 tasks beginning with pariññā; — exeg.: Buddhassa Bhagavato kiccâkic- caṃ karaṇiyâkaraṇiyaṃ pahīnaṃ ucchinnamūlaṃ ... āyatiṃ anuppādadhammaṃ, tasmā Buddho ~o, Nidd ll Be 155, 15 ( ad Sn 1105, q.v. infra ); catuhi maggehi kiccaṃ katvā ṭhito, Mp ll 259, 3 ( ad A l 162, 21* , q.v. infra ); katāvī ti, catuhi maggehi ( so read with v.l.; Ee dham°) ~o, Spk l 51, 13 ( ad S l 14, 10 ); catūhi maggehi soḷasannaṃ kiccānaṃ katattā ~aṃ, Dhp-a lV 142, 12 ( ad Dhp 386, q.v. infra ); pariññâdī- naṃ soḷasannaṃ kiccānaṃ katattā ~o, Th-a lll 15, 17 ( ad Th 711, q.v. infra ); — jhāyiṃ viraam ... ~aṃ anā- savaṃ ... atthi pañhena āgamaṃ, Sn 1105 = Dhp 386; Anuruddhena ~ena sikkhito, Th 433; pāragū anupâdāno ~o anāsavo tuṭṭho āyukkhayā hoti mut- to āghātanā yathā, 711; vītarāgā visaṃyuttā ~ā anāsavā, Thī 337; yo ca pabbajitaṃ hanti ~aṃ ma- hesinaṃ sa Kāḷasutte niraye cirarattāya paccati, Ja V 267, 22* ; ~o hi brāhmaṇo, S l 47, 33* ; ~e anāsave, 178, 28* ; pannabhāro visaṃyutto ~o anāsavo, A l 162, 21* ; yo ... Sakyamunī bhagavā ~o ... taṃ suga- taṃ saraṇattham upehi, Vv 881 (Vv-a 231, 20 ); bhāvitattā pi arahanto ~ā anāsavā nikkhipanti, 992 = Pv 221; Bv l 46; taṃ ~ena ... Tathāgatena attānaṃ upādāya bhaṇitaṃ, Mil 214, 27 ; ettāvatā bhikkhu ~o bhavati, Peṭ 124, 10 ; tīhi vijjāhi sampanno ~o anā- savo Gotamo, Ap 88, 7 ; samāhite citte vigatûpak- kilese ~ena paccāharitabbaṃ pavattetabban ti, Ud-a 10, 17 = lt-a l 21, 13 ≠ 21, 17 ; ~o pahīnasabbadukkho bhavissāmi, ll 172, 19 ; — ° -tā , f. [ abstr. of prec ] , the fact of having done what is to be done; yena ñāṇena bujjhanti ariyā ~aṃ, Mil 339, 4 ; — ° -bhāva-vibhāva- na , n., explaining the fact of having done what is to be done; attano ~ena tassa visayâtikkamaṃ pavedesi, Thī-a 163, 26 .

kaṭaka.cp: neut. 1. a bracelet; 2. a rocky cave.
kaṭaka.p: [Kaṭa+aka] (na) CL=7 A City. Kaṭaka(Pu, Na) [kaṭa+ṇvu] (1) Rocky cave (or) A bank of a mountain (or) a side of a mountain. (2) Bracelet.

kataka.p: [Kara+ta+ka] (pu,na) CL=7 [Kara karaṇesatthe ko ca. Sūci. 1va36. Ka+taka+gha. Vācappati.] (Pu) (1) A tree bearing nuts the seeds of which can be used to clear turbid water Strychnos potatorum. (2) A cup that is made of. (Na) (3) A potsherd that is for brushing the sole of the foot that has small lumps like a water-clearing nut with barbs or spikes. (Ti) (4) Causes conclusion.

kaṭâkaṭa , m ( fn ). [< 2 kaṭa + akaṭa ( qq.v. ) ?; cf. pa. and sa. katâkata, q.v.; Pan ll 1 60], a kind of juice made from mugga beans ( ct. so ) ; according to the ct.s ~ is used either of juice made from beans that have been cooked so that they are only partly done ( = thokaṃ siniddho, i.e., somewhat soft; Sp so; v. infra ) or juice that has been strained without stirring the beans (Vmv, Sp-ṭ [ quoting the gaṇṭhipadas] so; v. infra ) , thus implying that the beans have not been cooked to a mash; ~ contrasts with akaṭayūsa ( in- correctly defined in CPD s.v.; = asiniddho muggapa- citapānīyo, Sp 1092, 22 ); cf. sa. kṛtayūṣa: the juice of pulses prepared with salt and fat; v. MW, pW s.v.; ~ena attho hoti. anujānāmi bhikkhave -an ti, Vin l 206, 31 (~an ti so 'va thokaṃ siniddho, Sp 1092, 23 ); ~enā ti mugge pacitvā acāletvā parissāvitena mug- gayūsenā ti vadanti, Vmv ll 186, 19 qu. Sp-ṭ lll 304, 16 ( with the remark: gaṇṭhipadesu vuttaṃ); — Rem.: the meaning ascribed to ~ by the ct.s would seem to support the derivation < kaṭa + akaṭa: ( partly ) done, ( partly ) not done; cf. the usage of pa. and sa. katâkata.
